people.name: Abishai
people.line: David's nephew, one of his mighty men and commanders

people.name: Abner
people.line: Saul's cousin and commander of his army

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: So David and Abishai came to the people by night: and, behold, Saul lay sleeping within the place of the wagons, with his spear stuck in the ground at his head; and Abner and the people lay around him.
translations.bsb: That night David and Abishai came to the troops, and Saul was lying there asleep in the inner circle of the camp, with his spear stuck in the ground by his head. And Abner and the troops were lying around him.
translations.kjv: So David and Abishai came to the people by night: and, behold, Saul lay sleeping within the trench, and his spear stuck in the ground at his bolster: but Abner and the people lay round about him.
translations.asv: So David and Abishai came to the people by night: and, behold, Saul lay sleeping within the place of the wagons, with his spear stuck in the ground at his head; and Abner and the people lay round about him.
